definition: The practice of tying specific claims in a model's output back to specific supporting evidence, such as source documents or citations.
details: Grounding techniques (including citation generation) help users verify AI-generated claims and are an important tool for reducing the practical harm of hallucination.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. Boil it down and it is this: The practice of tying specific claims in a model's output back to specific supporting evidence, such as source documents or citations. Here is why it matters: Grounding techniques (including citation generation) help users verify AI-generated claims and are an important tool for reducing the practical harm of hallucination. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. That blueprint is Fine-Grained Grounding.
